details: DRAM-sharded weight stream investigation; user granted weight sharding freedom

Reference branch dram_nd_shard_spec: shard MUST be ONE tile-row tall x per_core_N wide. Their measurement: a core pinned to ONE bank saturates ~30GB/s regardless of request size; bank rotation across K-rows reaches ~370GB/s. A TALL shard (the shape team-lead proposed, [7168,192]) pins a core to one bank and measured NO FASTER than interleaved. Going with 1-tile-row shards.

Sample 1, grid 11x8, guard set. interleaved vs ND-sharded: 12/12 cells faster. bf16 128/256/512: -7.97/-3.86/-3.36 pct; bfp8 128/256/512: -8.82/-3.27/-3.78; cap1024 -6.2/-8.2; emb6144 -1.7/-3.25; count5120 -0.07/-0.41 (weights amortised by W_RESIDENT over 20 M-blocks). Correctness: maxabsdiff 0 vs interleaved. Captured ~20 pct of the no_w_xfer headroom. Next: attribute gate/up vs down, sweep GU_CHUNKS (chunking caps runs at 2 tiles of a 6-tile shard).

Zone attribution at focus cell (7168/5120/256 bf16_rm, 88 cores): reader_wg_issue mean 14034->7700 ns (-45pct), max 27075->15891 (-41pct) = the predicted 168->84 transaction halving. reader_wg_wait 11849->8210 (-31pct). writer_wup max 49461->45490. compute_gateup UNCHANGED (73062->72728) - phase 1 was never weight-gated. The wall-clock win lands in PHASE 2: reader_phase2 49070->45393, compute_down 38846->35173, writer_out_issue 42788->39092 (all -3.7 us mean). Mechanism = freed DRAM/NoC bandwidth, not a shorter phase-1 critical path.

WIN. Guard set 88 cores median-of-3: 12/12 faster, -0.09 to -11.7 pct. Predicate: win scales as 1/m_blocks (W_RESIDENT reads weights once per program) - count<=256 (1 M-block) -3.7..-11.7 pct; 512 (2 blocks) -3.5..-4.6; >=1024 (4+ blocks) -0.1..-0.8 (noise, never a regression across 60+ cells). Holds at 11x8 AND 11x10, both formats, emb 6144+7168. Correctness: 35 sharded cells bit-identical (maxabsdiff 0); golden 45/45 and unit dir 124 passed on the default interleaved path (1 pre-existing failure: reader_head_scheduling stale kernel copy, TA_BASE 25 vs 35 at HEAD). Captures 8-37 pct (median ~22) of the no_w_xfer ceiling. Transactions/core/M-block 534 -> ~230. DRAM footprint +2.2 pct. GU_CHUNKS stays 3 (1 and 2 both LOSE); WD_LATE still null.
